<thought>The spectrum shows a strong M+2 peak at ~33 % of the base peak (194 → 196) which is characteristic of chlorine (Cl‑35/Cl‑37). It also shows a smaller M+3 peak (~4 % of the base, 194 → 197) matching the 34S isotope pattern of sulfur. These patterns are distinctive enough to identify chlorine and sulfur definitively. No other element shows a uniquely diagnostic pattern in this data.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl', 'S']</final_answer>
